title: MOSOKO (Simple Lands)
style: 88 BPM warm indie pop, NZ AU vocal lean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brushed snare, soft analog synth pads, gentle bass, room reverb, male lead with breathy intimate delivery, layered group harmonies on chorus, slow build into open final chorus, ocean-room feel, doctrine track, contemplative and grounded, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — soft acoustic, brushed snare, ocean room]
MOSOKO… simple lands
MOSOKO… simple lands
The lesson lands when it's simple

[Verse 1]
Drew a map with a thousand lines
Every road, every crossing, every sign
Stood back and I couldn't read a thing
Too much weather, not enough wing

So I rubbed the map down to one clear road
One true direction, one light load
And the moment I did, the whole thing showed

[Pre-Chorus]
The hard ones hide behind a hundred words
The real ones land like a single bird
One branch, one breath, one easy thing

[Chorus]
MOSOKO — simple lands
Lay it down where the heart understands
No big speech, no grand demand
MOSOKO — simple lands
The lesson lands when it's simple, friend
The lesson lands when it's simple

[Verse 2]
Reading is easy, maths is easy
Spelling is easy, breathing is easy
Love is easy when you let it be
Tú ya sabes — you already see

All the noise was just a longer way
To say the thing you could've said today
So say it plain and let it stay

[Pre-Chorus]
The hard ones hide behind a hundred words
The real ones land like a single bird
One branch, one breath, one easy thing

[Chorus]
MOSOKO — simple lands
Lay it down where the heart understands
No big speech, no grand demand
MOSOKO — simple lands
The lesson lands when it's simple, friend
The lesson lands when it's simple

[Bridge — spoken, warm]
Not louder. Simpler.
Not bigger. Closer.
Not more. Truer.
MOSOKO.

[Final Chorus — lifted, harmonies open]
MOSOKO — simple lands
Lay it down where the heart understands
No big speech, no grand demand
MOSOKO — simple lands
The lesson lands when it's simple, friend
The lesson lands when it's simple

[Outro]
Simple lands… simple lands…
The lesson lands when it's simple
MOSOKO
